name: Hotel8
tagline: Hospitality on Sentin8 — property management, point of sale, distribution, metasearch, loyalty, and guest upsell as one composable vertical.
pillarsLead: Hotel8 inherits the Sentin8 security model by construction and adds hospitality's own guarantees — rate integrity, reservation atomicity, and PCI-clean money flows.

pillars.title: Property truth in one place
pillars.summary: PMS owns properties, room inventory, rate plans, reservations, and front-desk operations — every other service composes against it, never shadow-writes it.

pillars.title: Channel parity without leaks
pillars.summary: Distrib registers channels and maps room/rate inventory once; availability and restrictions flow outward, never inward unvalidated.

pillars.title: Payments delegated, never duplicated
pillars.summary: POS and PMS cashiering collect; money movement is delegated to Bank8:Payments — no vertical re-implements card rails.

pillars.title: Offers with consent discipline
pillars.summary: Upsell reacts to booking events within the guest's consent scope; pricing lanes present workload certificates, not static tokens.

pillars.title: Loyalty is deterministic
pillars.summary: Stay points award from check-out events through declarative rules; tier progress and redemptions are event-sourced and auditable.

units.name: Hotel8:PMS
units.summary: The property-management core: properties, room inventory, rate plans, reservations, front-desk operations, housekeeping, cashiering (folios), group blocks.

units.name: Hotel8:POS
units.summary: Food-and-beverage point of sale: outlets, tables, menu with modifiers, checks with split/merge lifecycle, kitchen routing, payments.

units.name: Hotel8:Upsell
units.summary: The offer-generation and guest-upsell engine: reacts to PMS booking events, generates context-appropriate offers (upgrades, early check-in), prices them through Bank8.

units.name: Hotel8:Distrib
units.summary: Channel distribution: registers OTA/GDS/wholesale/corporate/metasearch channels, maps channel-side properties and rate plans, pushes availability and restrictions.

units.name: Hotel8:Meta
units.summary: Metasearch integration (Google Hotel Ads, Trivago, Kayak, TripAdvisor, Skyscanner, Bing): channel registration, bid/pricing sync, booking link integrity.

units.name: Hotel8:Loyalty
units.summary: The guest-loyalty engine: reward programs and tiers, member enrollment and linking, stay points from PMS check-out events, earning rules and redemptions.

apps.name: ePMS
apps.summary: The property staff app: front desk, housekeeping boards, cashiering, reservations management.

apps.name: ePOS
apps.summary: The outlet staff app: table service, checks, kitchen routing, POS payments.

apps.name: eBooking
apps.summary: The guest booking app: availability search, rate display, reservation booking and management.

apps.name: eCorpBooking
apps.summary: The corporate booking app: negotiated rates, corporate policies, authorized-user booking.

apps.name: eGuest
apps.summary: The guest app: digital check-in, folio view, upsell offers, loyalty status.

apps.name: eKiosk
apps.summary: The lobby kiosk: self check-in/out, key pickup, upsell surfacing.

sdks.name: hotel8 Rust SDK
sdks.summary: The unified namespace facade (hotel8::pms::…, hotel8::pos::…) over the per-service contracts — the typed integration surface for every hotel8 API.

showcaseLead: Hotel8 contains no platform infrastructure of its own — identity, events, storage, scheduling, and money movement are delegated.

showcase.name: Sentin8 — the platform
showcase.summary: 17 services: identity, events, storage, workflows, scheduling — everything hotel8 doesn't rebuild.

showcase.name: Bank8
showcase.summary: Hotel8 delegates card and settlement flows to Bank8:Payments.
